title: Junior Draftsperson
content_text:
DOF is seeking a motivated Junior Draftsperson to join our Engineering & Drafting team in the Perth CBD.
Reporting to the Lead Draftsperson, you will build your career while contributing to complex projects across the offshore and subsea industry.
Prepare and maintain 2D technical drawings and documentation.
Develop storyboards and drafting packages to a high professional standard.
Liaise with engineers and project stakeholders to obtain design information.
Ensure drawings comply with relevant drafting standards and project requirements.
Review drawings for accuracy, consistency, and quality.
Requirements:
Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Civil & Structural Engineering, Technical Drafting, or a related discipline.
Proficiency in AutoCAD 2D.
Experience with Autodesk Vault (Desirable).
Ability to produce drawings in accordance with relevant drafting standards.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to review drawings for compliance and accuracy.
Ability to work collaboratively with engineers and project teams.
Location: Perth CBD with flexible hybrid options available
Application due date: Thursday October 15th 2026
Please apply by submitting your Resume with motivational Cover letter.
Only shortlisted applicants with full Australian working rights will be contacted.
apply_instructions: Apply via Workable portal with resume and motivational cover letter. Closing 15 October 2026.
